data.name: Lumbering Rage
data.description: At 10th level, whenever a ragechemist uses his rage mutagen ability, he may have the mutagen also give him a +2 morale bonus to Constitution, but when he takes a penalty on Will saving throws and to Intelligence, he also takes a -1 penalty to Dexterity. This ability replaces poison immunity.
